utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need the details, I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are we sure it’s actually happening today, or is that just chatter?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It sounds like it’s actually happening today, not just chatter. I’d still check with the organizers, but I’ve seen enough activity to think it’s on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and help out for a bit. I’ll tell the others too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nice — thanks for letting me know. I might stop by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll remind the others too. Hope you make it if you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with the front gate and that leaky faucet by the hall. Those seem like the most urgent ones.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll help with the gate first, then the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that’d be a big help. I’m keeping track of what we still need, so any word you spread would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll mention it to a few people I know and ask if they need anything fixed. Just let me know if there’s a specific item you want me to point out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking Saturday morning around 9, if that works with the school schedule. If not, we can shift it a bit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me—I can plan around that. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Maybe around 3 o’clock? That should give folks enough time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 3 o’clock works for me. Let’s stick with that and keep the plan clear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it — the repair drive sounds like a great idea. I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. If you could also mention the drop-off times and what items we can actually take, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll be sure to mention the drop-off times and the list of accepted items when I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still going on, but I only caught bits of it from the neighbors. Do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re still collecting basic tools, strong tape, a couple of hammers, and any spare screws or nails. If you have anything handy, I can make sure it gets added.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I might be able to find some screws and tape at home. I’ll check and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me what the repair drive needs and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s for fixing up donated bikes and small household items, and we’re doing it this Saturday morning at the community hall. If you want, I can tell you what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—what should I bring, and is there anything specific you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Uli — simple is good. I can swing by late and help with whatever’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Late works for me—just knock softly and we’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand for the repair drive—what tools or supplies do you need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. We need screwdrivers, a hammer, duct tape, and a few boxes for donations—can you bring any of those?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the screwdrivers, hammer, and some duct tape. I’ll also see if I have a few sturdy boxes to spare.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that—where should I note the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just jot it down at the community hall bulletin board—that’s where I’m putting the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note it on the community hall bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll check what we’re missing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just give me a shout once you’ve checked, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off details sorted first. Do we know where the repair drive is collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—do we have the collection point confirmed, or should we ask around first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s ask around first so we don’t end up hauling everything to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and see if a few neighbors can bring small repairs or tools? That would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for any small repairs or tools folks can bring. I’ll check in with a few neighbors and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve kept an eye on the supplies for the repair drive, so tell me what you still need and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a little late as usual, but I can help if you still need anything. What supplies are you short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, a few screwdrivers, and some spare nails. If you can bring any of that, it’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in to fix up the old community spots—pretty nice to see everyone helping out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, it’s been a good thing for the neighborhood. I’m trying to work around the school schedule so I can help out when I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense—school hours can be tricky. If you want, I can let you know when they’re planning the next work time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo! Could you help make a list of the needed repairs and maybe check in with a few neighbors for what they need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—I can make a quick list and ask a few neighbors what’s most urgent. I’ll keep it brief and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the cracks near the edge — if you’ve got any filler or patch mix, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring over some filler and patch mix later today. If you want, I’ll also check the edge cracks with you before we start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely telling everyone about the repair drive — the more hands, the better. Want me to spread the word to a few more folks too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — that’d be really helpful. I’m still catching up on who’s who, so any extra word would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the folks on my block and let them know it’s happening. If you want, I can also point people your way when I see them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t checked the repair drive locations yet, but I can help track them down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let’s keep it simple—if you check the locations, I’ll make a list so we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—I’ll check the locations and send you what I find so we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I want to make sure I get the details right before I say anything. Let me check and then I’ll tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No problem—just let me know when you’ve checked. I’d rather have the right list than guess.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s great news! I should probably bring by those old tools I’ve been meaning to sort through.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, even a few rusty tools might come in handy if they can still be fixed up. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything else.
